outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of USG and MRI for measuring lower segment cesarean scar thickness
Comparison of scar thickness measurements with surgical findings
cohort: 30 pregnant women considering trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) who eventually underwent lower segment cesarean section (LSCS)
finding: MRI did not offer an advantage over USG in terms of diagnostic accuracy for measuring lower segment cesarean scar thickness in women considering TOLAC.
